newsitem.title: USA: Patrick says will consider buyout offer.
newsitem.headline: Patrick says will consider buyout offer.

text.p: Patrick Industries Inc said it and a major shareholder have received a proposal for the acquisition of all of the shares of the company's stock.
"Discussions are ongoing at this time, but there are no assurances that any agreement can be reached. The board of directors will be considering the proposal," Patrick said.
Shares in Patrick closed Thursday up 3/8 at 16-5/8 in light over-the-counter trading.

Patrick makes and distributes building materials for manufactured housing, recreational vehicles and other industries. The company posted 1996 revenues of $403.5 million, up from $362.5 million in 1995.
The company declined to make any further comment on the acquisition proposal.
After falling in the first quarter, Patrick shares have run up since mid-April from about 13 on expectation of a deal, analysts said.
"It was just a matter of time," said Wellington Financial analyst Andrew Hill.
An offer of $20 to $22 per share, or $120 to $132 million, would likely take out the company, Hill speculated.
